questions.explanation: 根据后文的“balanced nutrition(均衡营养)”可知，挑战小组的重点是“锻炼(exercise)”与“营养”的结合，这是常见的健康生活搭配。sleep（睡眠）、breath（呼吸）、break（休息）均不如 exercise 符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(exercise)：语境句：Regular exercise is beneficial to your physical and mental health. 固定搭配：take exercise, physical exercise
B(sleep)：语境句：A good night's sleep is essential for proper brain function. 固定搭配：go to sleep, fall asleep
C(breath)：语境句：He took a deep breath and dived into the swimming pool. 固定搭配：catch one's breath, out of breath
D(break)：语境句：Let's take a short break to grab a cup of coffee. 固定搭配：take a break, coffee break

questions.explanation: 在社交媒体平台上发布照片，最恰当的动词是 post（发布，发帖子）。hung（悬挂）、took（拍摄，指拍照动作本身而不指发布）、drew（画）均不符合社交媒体分享的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(hung)：语境句：She hung the painting on the wall to decorate her new room. 固定搭配：hang up, hang out
B(posted)：语境句：He posted his travel photos on social media to share with friends. 固定搭配：post online, keep someone posted
C(took)：语境句：He took some amazing pictures during his trip to Tibet. 固定搭配：take photos, take time
D(drew)：语境句：She drew a beautiful portrait of her mother for her birthday. 固定搭配：draw a conclusion, draw attention

questions.explanation: 前文提到“我忘记了接受和认可需要源于内心”，说明作者是在没意识到的情况下给儿子树立了坏榜样，故选 unknowingly（不知不觉地）。unwillingly（不情愿地）、untiringly（不倦地）、unfailingly（无一例外地）均不符合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(unwillingly)：语境句：He unwillingly admitted his mistake after being questioned. 固定搭配：unwillingly accept, do sth unwillingly
B(untiringly)：语境句：The volunteers worked untiringly to help the earthquake victims. 固定搭配：work untiringly, strive untiringly
C(unknowingly)：语境句：She had unknowingly exposed her personal information to hackers. 固定搭配：unknowingly cause, do sth unknowingly
D(unfailingly)：语境句：He is unfailingly polite to everyone he meets. 固定搭配：unfailingly polite, unfailingly supportive

questions.explanation: 对比现在社交媒体“统治”生活，以前上网只是“偶尔的(occasional)”消遣，大部分时间用来读书看报。abrupt（突然的）、constant（持续不断的，与过去情况相反）、usual（寻常的）均不贴切。
questions.supplement:
A(abrupt)：语境句：His abrupt departure from the meeting surprised everyone. 固定搭配：an abrupt end, an abrupt change
B(occasional)：语境句：She likes playing tennis, but only on an occasional basis. 固定搭配：occasional rain, on an occasional basis
C(constant)：语境句：The patient requires constant care and observation. 固定搭配：constant complaints, constant change
D(usual)：语境句：As usual, he was the last one to arrive at the office. 固定搭配：as usual, the usual way

questions.explanation: 与电子邮件(emails)和打电话(phone calls)并列的日常联络方式应为 texts（短信）。films（电影）、novels（小说）、diaries（日记）不是通讯方式。
questions.supplement:
A(films)：语境句：Watching foreign films is a great way to improve language skills. 固定搭配：shoot a film, direct a film
B(novels)：语境句：She enjoys reading science fiction novels in her spare time. 固定搭配：read novels, write a novel
C(diaries)：语境句：Keeping diaries helps her reflect on her daily experiences. 固定搭配：keep a diary, write in a diary
D(texts)：语境句：They prefer communicating through texts rather than phone calls. 固定搭配：send texts, text messages

questions.explanation: 作者注销账号是为了“再现/重塑(recreate)”过去的质朴生活。replace（替换）、recall（回忆，停留在脑海中）、review（复习/回顾）不如 recreate 体现作者采取实际行动去恢复过去的生活状态。
questions.supplement:
A(replace)：语境句：We need to replace the old equipment with more advanced ones. 固定搭配：replace A with B, replace sb as...
B(recall)：语境句：I can hardly recall the exact details of that event. 固定搭配：recall doing sth, beyond recall
C(recreate)：语境句：The museum aims to recreate the historical scene for its visitors. 固定搭配：recreate the atmosphere, recreate the scene
D(review)：语境句：It's highly recommended to review your notes before the exam. 固定搭配：review the lessons, a book review

questions.explanation: be in the habit of doing sth 是固定搭配，表示“有做某事的习惯”。作者过去有每天多次查看社交媒体的习惯。
questions.supplement:
A(custom)：语境句：It is a local custom to exchange gifts during the festival. 固定搭配：local custom, social custom
B(habit)：语境句：Getting up early is a good habit that benefits your health. 固定搭配：be in the habit of, form a habit
C(skill)：语境句：Learning a new language requires patience and communication skill. 固定搭配：improve a skill, practical skill
D(ability)：语境句：She has the ability to solve complex mathematical problems. 固定搭配：have the ability to do, reading ability

questions.explanation: 作者停用了社交媒体，有了空闲时间，所以必须“想出/找到(come up with)”新事物来做。get rid of（摆脱）、keep away from（远离）、break away from（脱离）均不符合寻找新爱好的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(get rid of)：语境句：He is trying to get rid of his old car and buy a new one. 固定搭配：get rid of bad habits, get rid of poverty
B(keep away from)：语境句：Parents should keep children away from dangerous chemicals. 固定搭配：keep away from danger, keep away from fire
C(come up with)：语境句：Our team came up with a brilliant idea for the marketing campaign. 固定搭配：come up with a solution, come up with an idea
D(break away from)：语境句：It is difficult for him to break away from traditional ideas. 固定搭配：break away from tradition, break away from the past

questions.explanation: 为了不看手机，作者随身“携带(carried)”一本填字游戏书。carry around 是固定搭配，意为“随身携带”。
questions.supplement:
A(carried)：语境句：She carried a small notebook around to write down ideas. 固定搭配：carry around, carry out
B(bought)：语境句：I bought some fresh vegetables from the supermarket. 固定搭配：buy sth for sb, buy off
C(borrowed)：语境句：He borrowed a dictionary from the library to help with his translation. 固定搭配：borrow sth from sb, borrow money
D(wrote)：语境句：She wrote a letter of apology to explain her absence. 固定搭配：write down, write to sb

questions.explanation: 语境表达作者一家生活得很幸福，很幸运一年能负担得起两次共同度过的“假期(vacations)”。tickets（票）、weekends（周末，一年有52个，不符常理）、treats（款待）均不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(tickets)：语境句：I have booked two tickets for the concert this Saturday. 固定搭配：book tickets, flight tickets
B(weekends)：语境句：We usually spend our weekends hanging out with friends. 固定搭配：on weekends, at the weekend
C(treats)：语境句：My uncle bought us ice cream as a special treat. 固定搭配：a special treat, treat sb to sth
D(vacations)：语境句：We are planning to take two vacations to Europe next year. 固定搭配：on vacation, summer vacation

questions.explanation: 作者找到了新爱好，回到了现实生活，因此“停止(stopped)”了透过手机看世界。enjoyed（享受）、imagined（想象）、admitted（承认）均与作者摆脱手机依赖的语境相反。
questions.supplement:
A(stopped)：语境句：He stopped smoking entirely for the sake of his health. 固定搭配：stop doing sth, stop sb from doing
B(enjoyed)：语境句：We greatly enjoyed our stay at the beautiful resort. 固定搭配：enjoy doing sth, enjoy oneself
C(imagined)：语境句：I never imagined that I would meet my primary school friend here. 固定搭配：imagine doing sth, hard to imagine
D(admitted)：语境句：He reluctantly admitted having made a serious mistake. 固定搭配：admit doing sth, admit to sth

questions.explanation: 几周后作者重返社交媒体，查看朋友孩子们长大的“照片(photos)”，与前文的 posted a photo 呼应。news（新闻）、notices（通知）、reports（报告）不符合看孩子成长动态的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(news)：语境句：Have you heard the good news about his promotion? 固定搭配：break the news, latest news
B(notices)：语境句：There are some important notices pinned on the bulletin board. 固定搭配：put up a notice, until further notice
C(reports)：语境句：According to the latest reports, the economy is recovering slowly. 固定搭配：weather report, write a report
D(photos)：语境句：She showed me some beautiful photos of her graduation ceremony. 固定搭配：take photos, share photos

questions.explanation: 经过休息调整后，作者现在能够“感激/欣赏(appreciate)”社交媒体带来的好处（如与远方家人保持联系）。forgive（原谅）、question（质疑）、wonder（想知道）均不合题意。
questions.supplement:
A(appreciate)：语境句：I really appreciate your timely help during the crisis. 固定搭配：appreciate doing sth, highly appreciate
B(forgive)：语境句：I hope you can forgive me for my careless mistake. 固定搭配：forgive sb for doing, forgive and forget
C(question)：语境句：Nobody dared to question his authority in the company. 固定搭配：out of the question, without question
D(wonder)：语境句：I wonder if you could do me a favor and give me a ride. 固定搭配：no wonder, wonder about

questions.explanation: 作者现在每天也会看社交媒体，但不再有频繁更新的“欲望(desire)”了。promise（承诺）、advice（建议）、mood（情绪）不符合此处表达的内心冲动。
questions.supplement:
A(promise)：语境句：He made a promise that he would never lie to me again. 固定搭配：make a promise, keep a promise
B(desire)：语境句：She has a strong desire to travel around the world. 固定搭配：have a desire to do, a burning desire
C(advice)：语境句：My teacher gave me some valuable advice on how to improve my writing. 固定搭配：give advice, take one's advice
D(mood)：语境句：Listening to light music always puts me in a good mood. 固定搭配：in a good mood, in no mood for

questions.explanation: 文章主旨是作者摆脱了对社交媒体的沉迷。最后总结说，社交媒体对她而言不再是一种“上瘾(addiction)”。excuse（借口）、advantage（优势）、experience（经历）不能总结作者的心路历程。
questions.supplement:
A(excuse)：语境句：There is no excuse for your arriving late for the interview. 固定搭配：make an excuse, find an excuse
B(advantage)：语境句：Living in a big city has the advantage of convenient transportation. 固定搭配：take advantage of, have an advantage over
C(experience)：语境句：She has a lot of experience in dealing with customer complaints. 固定搭配：gain experience, rich in experience
D(addiction)：语境句：His addiction to computer games has severely affected his academic performance. 固定搭配：Internet addiction, overcome an addiction

section_2_word_form.passage:
Despite being a lesser-known Chinese sport, the game of jianzi is definitely familiar to people in Asia. Who hasn't seen a group of elderly men kicking around [56] colourful, feathered shuttlecock(毽子) in the park?

Dating all the way back [57] the ancient Zhou Dynasty of China, the sport of jianzi was mainly played among Chinese youth as a [58] way to exercise. It is believed that the fundamental gameplay and style came from a football-like game [59] cuju. Due to the game's simplicity and ease of play, many children created makeshift shuttlecocks at home, [60] round pieces of lead or tin with chicken feathers. During the war-torn Dynasties of Han and Song from 207 to 906 AD, the [61] of jianzi exploded. Leaders used the game [62] their troops alongside military exercises.

In 1933, China hosted the first national jianzi competition after the sport's massive rise. A 1961 movie [63] talked about the game won a gold medal at an international film festival, further spreading the word about the sport. In 1984, jianzi [64] officially as a Chinese national sport, and that same year saw the creation of the Hong Kong-based team, Amateur Union of Shuttlecock. By 1994, the Hong Kong team [65] grew into a reformed union known as the Hong Kong Association of Shuttlecock(HKSA).

questions.explanation: 此处泛指“一个”色彩缤纷、带羽毛的毽子。shuttlecock 为可数名词单数，且 colourful 发音以辅音音素开头，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：I need to buy a new laptop for my upcoming college studies. 固定搭配：a piece of, a pair of。其它变形/搭配：an (用于元音发音前), the (定冠词表示特指)。

questions.explanation: date back to 是固定搭配，意为“追溯到”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：The custom of eating turkey on Thanksgiving dates back to the 17th century. 固定搭配：date back to, lead to。其它变形/搭配：None。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 way，需要用形容词形式。create 的形容词是 creative，意为“有创造力的，创造性的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(creative)：语境句：She always comes up with creative ideas for our team projects. 固定搭配：creative thinking, highly creative。原词create其它变形：creation(n.), creator(n.), creatively(adv.)。

questions.explanation: game 与 name 之间是动宾关系（被命名为），因此使用过去分词 named 作后置定语修饰 game。
questions.supplement: 正确形(named)：语境句：I adopted a stray dog and named him Max. 固定搭配：be named after, namely。原词name其它变形：namely(adv.), nameless(adj.)。

questions.explanation: children 与 use 之间是主动关系，此处用现在分词 using 作伴随状语，表示“用……（制作）”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(using)：语境句：They managed to solve the problem using a completely new approach. 固定搭配：use up, make use of。原词use其它变形：useful(adj.), useless(adj.), usage(n.)。

questions.explanation: 定冠词 the 之后应接名词作主语，popular 的名词形式是 popularity，意为“受欢迎，普及”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(popularity)：语境句：The new smartphone has gained immense popularity among young people. 固定搭配：gain popularity, grow in popularity。原词popular其它变形：popularize(v.), popularly(adv.)。

questions.explanation: use sth to do sth 是固定句型，表示“使用某物去做某事”，此处用动词不定式作目的状语。
knowledge_points: 动词不定式作目的状语
questions.supplement: 正确形(to train)：语境句：The company hired a professional coach to train the new employees. 固定搭配：train sb to do sth, training program。原词train其它变形：training(n.), trainer(n.), trainee(n.)。

questions.explanation: 此处为限制性定语从句，先行词是 A 1961 movie（物），且在从句中作主语，所以填关系代词 that 或 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that/which)：语境句：The book that I bought yesterday is extremely fascinating. 固定搭配：in that, which is to say。其它变形/搭配：who, whom, whose。

questions.explanation: 主语 jianzi 与 recognize 为被动关系，且根据时间状语 In 1984 可知，时态为一般过去时，故填 was recognized。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was recognized)：语境句：His outstanding contribution to the field of science was universally recognized. 固定搭配：recognize A as B, be recognized as。原词recognize其它变形：recognition(n.), recognizable(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词 grew，需要使用副词。steady 的副词形式为 steadily，意为“稳定地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(steadily)：语境句：The company's profits have been steadily increasing over the past five years. 固定搭配：grow steadily, increase steadily。原词steady其它变形：steady(adj. 作为形容词), steadiness(n.)。
